messages:
alex: Heads up — Quantum AI POC asking for a Dedicated commit (4x A100) but finance flagged the burst surcharge on mixed GPU pools. They want a POC-level cap to avoid unexpected charges. Can we approve a 10% cap on burst surcharge for the POC period (30 days)?

maria_se: What's the current default? I thought burst surcharges are usage-based and can spike depending on pool mix.

jordan_ops: Default is dynamic — we see up to ~30% on mixed pools during peak. 10% is possible as a temporary carveout but needs capacity guardrails.

priya_fin: Finance: 10% cap seems reasonable for a 30-day POC if sales signs a liability clause. Need explicit SOW line and a billing flag so we can audit.

alex: I can add the SOW clause. What exactly should the liability language say?

sam_legal: Suggested language (draft): 'Customer burst surcharge will be capped at 10% of the committed rate during the POC period (30 days). Customer remains liable for actual usage beyond the committed baseline; the cap applies only to the burst premium and is subject to available capacity.' I'll run a quick review.

maria_se: Operational ask: we should pin GPUs to avoid autoscale swapping into higher-cost SKUs. Can we reserve an A100-only pool for the POC window?

jordan_ops: We can carve out a temporary A100-only pool but it consumes capacity credits. For a 4x commit that's feasible. Autoscale policy must set max_priority to 'poc' so the pool isn't preempted.

mike_ml: Technical note: model footprints and 4k token sequences mean continuous batching will still cause token skew. Recommend limiting concurrency to 48 to keep p95 latency stable.

ben_platform: I'll add a billing flag 'poc_quantum_cap' to invoice metadata and route daily usage dumps to the salesops S3 bucket. Also wire up an alert if daily burst > 8% so finance can be notified early.

priya_fin: Need the exact SOW snippet and customer email approval. SalesOps, please collect signatures. Once we have that we can sign off from finance.

alex: Draft SOW snippet below — please comment before I send to customer:

```
SOW ADDENDUM - QUANTUM AI POC (30 DAYS)
- Commitment: Dedicated A100 pool equivalent to 4x A100 sustained throughput.
- Burst surcharge cap: Provider will cap burst surcharge at 10% of the committed rate for the POC period (30 days).
- Billing: Provider will apply the cap to the burst premium only; customer remains liable for consumption beyond the committed baseline.
- Capacity: The cap is subject to available capacity; Provider may fallback to compatible model variants if A100 capacity is unavailable.
- Audit: Daily usage reports will be shared to the billing S3 bucket with flag 'poc_quantum_cap'.
```

sam_legal: LGTM apart from clarifying 'subject to available capacity' — maybe add an explicit fallback sentence (see SOW addendum line 4).

alex: Added fallback sentence. I'll send to Quantum now. @priya_fin @jordan_ops pls watch the billing flag and carveout ticket.

dealbot: :information_source: Capacity carveout request created — ticket #CARVE-7421. Assigned to jordan_ops.

jordan_ops: Received CARVE-7421. Will provision A100 pool and set autoscale policy. ETA ~8 business hours.

alex: :thumbsup:
